filter: judgment categories only; numeric/threshold titles removed; lifetime>=7d; one market per event (longest lifetime, ties by ticker); MVE combos excluded; resolved in [2026-06-20, 2026-08-28)
note: Question titles are Kalshi's content and are not redistributed. Rows are keyed by question_id, which is the venue's own market ticker, so the text is retrievable from the venue's public API by that id, subject to its terms. The PROMPT is not the title: see prompt_construction, and scripts/kalshi_subtitles.py + scripts/kalshi_rebuild_prompts.py, which rebuild it exactly. verify.py joins on question_id and never reads text, so every number on the card is reproducible from this file.
prompt_construction: if yes_sub_title appears in title: title unchanged; else title (trailing '?' removed) + ' — resolves YES if: ' + yes_sub_title. yes_sub_title re-fetched from the live API; it is in no archived source.
